ai_summary: Blue Dart Express Limited demonstrated strong operational performance for the half-year ended September 30, 2026, with revenue from operations growing by approximately 14.7% and Net Profit increasing by nearly 49% year-on-year, accompanied by a significant improvement in operating cash flow. However, cash and cash equivalents materially decreased by 48% from the beginning of the fiscal year due to higher investments in mutual funds and capital expenditures, which warrants careful monitoring of liquidity.
